d:
Dharavahik- gopichand ki amar kahaniyan
Nirmata- ti.saee chand
Nirdeshak- mohan koda
Gopichand aadhunik telugu sahity kshetr men mahan upanyaskar evan kahaniyon ke ek anokhe lekhak mane jate hain | unhonne manavta ke prati gahan adhyayan kiya | unhonne san 1930 se 1962 tak vibhinn vishyon par 300 se adhik kahaniyon evan 10 upanyason ki rachna ki | is dharavahik men san 1940 se 1960 tak aandhrapradesh ke gramin evan chhote-chhote pranton ke jivan ko darshaya gaya hai |
